newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party evaluates interactive relations with opposition Democratic Progressive Party.
Constitutional reforms face changing factors amid deeply varied opinions among ruling and opposition parties.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Provincial Governor James Soong questions ruling Nationalist Party's route.
Taiwan detains two mainland Chinese fishing boats that invaded island's fishing waters.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui's decision to promote constitutional reform has not changed.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Economics ministry completes initial proposal to regulate Taiwan investments in mainland China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Provincial Assembly to review privatisation of "big three" state-run commercial banks.
